strategy: Complete geographically connected clusters before opening isolated metros.

completedBaseline.note: All existing super-enrichment campaign verifiers pass locally. Production publication remains a maintainer decision.

activeCluster.name: South Florida Atlantic evidence restoration
activeCluster.reason: Okeeheelee Park now has four evidence-complete destinations covering family play, paddling, disc golf, and public golf, alongside the completed Dreher Park and Hugh Taylor Birch State Park guides. Snyder Park remains deferred because its official visitor records are strong but the current reusable image set still fails the representative-gallery gate.
activeCluster.releaseStandard: Retain official parent answers, require three to four current representative reusable photographs per released parent, and publish only named subsites with exact reviewed coordinates, destination-specific photography, and current operator guidance.

completed: Fixed the parent-information merge so later image-only campaign records no longer erase richer official visitor facts.
Restored 937 sourced answers across 66 parent parks in 35 metros, including 43 answers across Railroad Park, Red Mountain Park, and Ruffner Mountain.
Strengthened the shared verifier so every campaign now checks the public generated parent answer set, not only the source record.
All 51 super-enrichment campaign verifiers pass with zero failures.
Published three evidence-complete Railroad Park destinations: West Green, 17th Street Plaza, and Adventure Playground.
Published Ruffner Mountain Quarry with an official-map match, exact licensed-photo geotag, seasonal preserve hours, parking guidance, and quarry safety context.
Expanded Railroad Park's parent gallery with destination-specific licensed photos so the parent page and subsite pages stay visually consistent.
Published Red Mountain Park's Frankfurt Drive Entrance from current operator guidance, an official trail map, and a geotagged licensed entrance photograph.
Deferred Red Mountain Park's remaining subsites rather than publishing unmatched photos or uncertain destination coordinates.
Published and deployed three evidence-complete Myriad Botanical Gardens destinations: Inasmuch Foundation Crystal Bridge Conservatory, Children's Garden, and Water Stage.
Verified all 51 campaign suites and the active Vercel preview after the Oklahoma City release.
Published and preview-deployed Albuquerque's North Launch Field, Kiwanis Reservation Area, and Central Pond with exact reviewed coordinates and destination-matched licensed photography.
Corrected Elena Gallegos Open Space's parent map position from a stale south-side coordinate to the official Tramway Boulevard recreation area.

Published and preview-deployed Forest Park Miniature Railroad Trinity Park Depot and Trinity Park Duck Pond with exact reviewed positions, destination-matched licensed photographs, and destination-specific visitor answers.
Published the Aerated Pool as the third signature Fort Worth Water Gardens destination from an exact geotagged CC BY-SA photograph and current City operating and no-swimming guidance.
Verified all 51 super-enrichment campaign suites after completing the Fort Worth release, with 12 evidence-complete Southwest destinations and zero campaign failures.
Published Dreher Park with four contextual CC-licensed views representing Palm Beach Zoo and Cox Science Center rather than animal close-ups alone.

Published Palm Beach Zoo and Conservation Society plus Cox Science Center and Aquarium as exact destination pages with current ticket, hours, parking, accessibility, family, pet, and construction guidance.
Added per-intent destination sourcing so ticket and accessibility answers cite the exact official operator pages that support each claim.
Published Okeeheelee Park with four representative CC-licensed views covering paddling, playground use, public golf, and disc golf.
Published Okeeheelee Disc Golf Course and Okeeheelee Golf Course as exact destination pages with official hours, arrival, fees, accessibility, family, pet, weather, and facility guidance.
Verified all 51 super-enrichment campaigns plus national discovery and North Carolina image, gallery, performance, and SEO checks after the first Okeeheelee release.
Released Great Park in Irvine with four licensed photographs and exact destination pages for Great Park Balloon, Championship Soccer Stadium, and Wild Rivers, clearing its deferred-photo mission.

Expanded Okeeheelee Park with exact Okeeheelee Playground and Okeeheelee Canoe and Kayak Area pages using Palm Beach County's CC BY photography, April 2026 ADA map, current visitor guidance, and reviewed OpenStreetMap pins.
Reverified all 51 super-enrichment campaigns, national discovery, and North Carolina release safeguards after the Okeeheelee family-and-water expansion.
resumeCheckpoint.nextAction: Continue geographically connected South Florida Atlantic coverage with Fort Lauderdale and Hollywood public beach, waterfront, and nature destinations that can clear the official-information and reusable-photo gates. nextClusters: Add the next South Florida Atlantic parent cluster from high-demand Fort Lauderdale and Hollywood public beach, waterfront, and nature destinations only when each parent clears the official-information and three-to-four-image gates.
Restore Snyder Park only after permission-cleared broad park, trail, dog-lake, playground, disc-golf, or butterfly-garden images replace the current no-derivatives results.

Expand Okeeheelee Park only when exact reusable photo-and-pin pairs clear review for its Nature Center, Pooch Pines, BMX track, wake park, mountain-bike trailhead, equestrian center, fishing areas, pavilions, or entrances.
